meta.title: Argus finished product: five screens, one flow
meta.honesty: Nothing on these screens is a model result. P0 (bench) and P1 (repro, fixture replay) are the only built phases. Every screen is labelled BUILT TODAY, PARTLY BUILT or PLANNED (Pn). Mock values carry an ILLUSTRATIVE or SIMULATED tag. Metrics are '—' unless a run id backs them. No real PR is ever created by the prototype.
meta.ownerFlow: Owner types an issue (text, optionally a screenshot) -> agent returns an HTML report with before and after on the UI -> owner verifies -> on satisfaction the agent raises the PR.
meta.planFlow: Labelled GitHub issue -> webhook hint -> durable DBOS workflow (Render + Neon) -> job on GitHub Actions -> draft PR -> QA signal (MRTR or review comment) -> ready PR -> backport bot.

triggers.label: Type it here
triggers.blurb: Text box plus optional screenshot. Not scheduled in PLAN.md. Needs an HTTP endpoint on the P6 FastAPI service and a page (the P5 dashboard is a static GitHub Pages site and cannot post a form).

triggers.label: Labelled GitHub issue
triggers.blurb: Someone adds the label `argus` to an issue on an installed repo. The webhook is a hint (returns 202); the reconcile poller rebuilds state from GitHub. A label from a user without write access is ignored and logged (P8-T24).

stages.label: Reproduce
stages.note: repro-agent writes a Playwright spec from the ticket; kept only if it fails on the buggy tree and passes on the golden tree. Today every reply is canned (host=fixture).

stages.label: Locate
stages.note: Vite plugin stamps data-src=file:line:col; locate() maps a selector to source candidates.

stages.label: Fix
stages.note: From-scratch agent loop in a git worktree + Docker --network none; gates run before submit.

stages.label: Verify
stages.note: Pixel, overflow, axe, console checks first; cross-family judge second; judge never overrides a passed check run.

workflowStates.status: PROPOSED. P6-T02 owns the real state list. Only awaiting-qa and done are named in the phase files.

scenarios.label: Normal
scenarios.effect: All four stages finish; four checks pass; judge label pass. Approve is enabled.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.effect: Run stops in Fix with stop_reason QuotaExceeded. State quota-wait. Retry is disabled until the UTC reset; no retry spam.

scenarios.label: Stuck
scenarios.effect: Run repeats one tool call in Locate until stop_reason stuck. Stop and Retry (new run_id) are offered; the old run is never mutated.

scenarios.label: Verifier failed
scenarios.effect: Overflow check fails on a second route (collateral damage). Verdict is fail, Approve is disabled, no PR is offered; one retry with the reason in context is allowed.

scenarios.label: Judge disagrees
scenarios.effect: All four checks pass, judge says fail. The judge does not override a passed check run, so Approve stays enabled but needs a written reason; the card says advisory while alpha is not calibrated.

differsFromPlan.title: 'Production UI' vs the synthetic-only rule
differsFromPlan.ownerFlow: Before and after are shown on the production UI.
differsFromPlan.plan: Free-tier prompts may be used for training, so only synthetic or public code goes through them; the P8 target is one of your own public repos; bench runs the dcortex synthetic cell.

differsFromPlan.action: 'Request changes' re-runs with the reviewer note as extra context. It is new; no task owns it.

ticket.text:
Text smaller than 12 px in many places (Radar, Horizon, Flights, Control Tower, admin tags).

On a phone at arm's length, 10 to 11 px text is hard to read. Radar detail cards show CRITICAL, GROUND TIME, MINIMUM and DEPARTURE DELAY at 10 px.

Set a floor of 12 px for any text. No visible text under 12 px on any screen.
ticket.textNote: Shortened for the form: the real ticket.json text is longer (it also lists Horizon, Flights, Control Tower and admin tags).

screens.purpose: Give the owner enough to decide: the structured verdict (four checks), the judge label and its limits, the before/after fix report, then Approve, Request changes or Reject with reasons.

built.label: PARTLY BUILT

delivery.what: Bench Verdict {task_id, ok, checks[{type, ok, reason}], log}; scorer exit 0/1/2
Repro verdict enum valid | passes-on-bug | fails-on-golden | error
Structured verdict with per-check results and first-failure reason (P4-T06); judge (P4-T13/T14); best-of-k (P4-T19); retry on rejection (P4-T22)
QA signal wait with timeout and idempotency key (P6-T08); MRTR elicitation (P6-T09) or review-comment fallback (P6-T10); ADR-023 picks
Before and after screenshots in the PR (P8-T09)
Standalone HTML fix report, designed in the fix-report lane

actions: Approve (optional note; required note when the judge disagrees)
Request changes (reason required; re-runs with your note)
Choose the QA signal channel: MRTR or review comment (ADR-023)

states.text: Four checks pass; judge pass labelled advisory until alpha is calibrated; Approve enabled.
A check fails: verdict fail, first failure named with its route, Approve disabled; one retry or Reject.
Checks pass, judge fails: red judge card, Approve needs a written reason; the verdict itself is not changed by the judge.
A check or the judge is `error` (backend down): amber, never green; decide on checks only.
awaiting-qa past the QA timeout: buttons replaced by 'Re-request review' (P6-T08).
409: another reviewer already decided; show the winner and close the pane.

edgeCases: Judge disagrees with passed checks: label shown, verdict unchanged (P4 goal).
alpha below 0.80: judge card says advisory only (ADR-013).
Font-loading flake: pixel diff red but the diff shows text only: offer one re-run and count it (P4-T26).
Missing before or after image: the check is `error`, never `pass`.
Ticket text carrying an injected instruction is shown as plain text; flagged if the judge output echoes it (P4-T27).
Confidence limits: a resolve rate on n tasks is shown with its Wilson interval; a difference smaller than the interval is 'no difference' (PLAN.md:286).

differs.note: Owner reviews a before/after HTML report before any PR exists. In the plan the review happens on a draft PR via MRTR or a review comment.
'Request changes' has no task; the plan's QA signal is approve or reject.
Before/after in the owner's description is on the production UI. The plan screenshots the synthetic dcortex cell; see D4.
